title: Emma

vibeProfile.oneLine: A clever young woman meddles in everyone's romance except her own.

summary: Handsome, clever and rich, Emma Woodhouse is convinced she has a gift for matchmaking, and proceeds to meddle in her neighbours' hearts with disastrous, comic results, blind all the while to her own. Austen gives us a heroine, she said, whom no one but herself would much like, and turns her small country village into a perfect stage for misjudgement and self-discovery. Wickedly funny and beautifully constructed, it is many readers' favourite Austen and a masterclass in comic irony.
whyReadIt: Austen's funniest and most perfectly built comedy, with a heroine who gets everything wrong. A masterclass in irony.

funFacts.text: Austen predicted Emma would be a heroine 'whom no one but myself will much like'.
